description: Manages n8n workflow automation in production — credential management, execution monitoring, error handling, workflow versioning, worker health, and blocked workflow recovery. Covers the Base44 Bearer credentials pattern and SCH-02 lane field fix for the FlashFusion platform. Activates when running n8n in production, fixing blocked or failing workflows, rotating n8n credentials, monitoring execution logs, handling silent workflow failures, diagnosing n8n errors, setting up error alerting, managing workflow versions, or debugging n8n integration with Supabase or Base44. Also triggers on: n8n down, workflow not running, credential expired, execution failed, n8n cloud vs self-hosted, n8n webhook error. NOTE: n8n MCP is currently CONNECTION_ISSUE. All live ops use manual fallbacks at https://krosebrook.app.n8n.cloud until MCP is restored.
